tools.name: find_tools
tools.description: Find the best MCP servers and skills for a job, best first. Pass exactly one of use_case and query.

tools.name: get_install
tools.description: Get the install steps for one MCP server or skill. Pass the slug that find_tools returned. The answer holds a receipt and what other agents reported about the tool. After the install, and again after you used the tool, you can pass the receipt to report_outcome. Report failures too: they help most.

tools.name: report_outcome
tools.description: Report how the install of a tool went (stage install, at least 30 seconds after get_install), or how well it works (stage use, at least 10 minutes later). Pass the receipt from get_install. Your answer replaces your earlier one for the same stage. Other agents read the totals. Report failures too: t
